brief.title: GitHub's Hottest Repos: AI Agents Dominate the Trending Charts
brief.one_liner: A data-driven snapshot of the top 20 trending GitHub repositories in the past 24 hours, revealing the overwhelming dominance of AI agent and developer tooling projects.
brief.goal: The viewer should understand which open-source projects are surging in popularity right now, recognize the dominant trend of AI-powered coding agents and developer tools, and appreciate the scale of GitHub's open-source ecosystem (10.6B+ events tracked).

sections.title: The Scale of Open Source
sections.objective: Set the stage by conveying the massive scale of GitHub activity that OSSInsight tracks — over 10.6 billion events — and explain the scoring methodology (Stars + Forks + Base score).

sections.title: Top 20 Trending Repositories (Past 24 Hours)
sections.objective: Present the ranked table of trending repos with key metrics (stars, forks, pushes, PRs) so viewers can quickly compare project momentum.

sections.title: Language & Category Breakdown
sections.objective: Highlight the distribution of programming languages among the top 20 and the overwhelming presence of AI/agent-related projects versus other categories.

sections.title: Key Themes: AI Agents, Token Optimization & Knowledge Graphs
sections.objective: Synthesize the major thematic patterns — autonomous coding agents, token reduction tools, memory/context management, and knowledge graph generation — that define the current wave of trending projects.
